name: Quantum Information Theory
description: Introduction to quantum information theory; review of mathematical tools: linear algebra, Hilbert spaces, semi-definite programming; quantum states and measurements; quantum channels; quantum teleportation; Bell inequality and CHSH game; Distinguishability measures for states and channels; quantum entropies and information; quantum data compression; entanglement measures; entanglement-assisted classical communication; entanglement distillation; quantum channel capacity; secret key distillation and private communication.
